title: TXT parser treats chapter-like dialogue lines as real chapter headings
symptom: Parser regression tests confirmed that body lines such as `第1章 她想：开始了吗？` and `第十三回合：还要继续吗？` were accepted as Chinese numbered chapter candidates. In a real chapter body, those lines would split the current chapter incorrectly and break downstream body offsets.
root_cause: The Chinese numbered chapter rule allowed sentence-ending punctuation whenever a colon appeared after the chapter suffix. That kept real subtitle-style headings like `第2章 独行者2:穿越者？玩家？神？`, but it was too broad for body dialogue and for words such as `回合` where `回` was parsed as the chapter suffix and the following `合：...？` became a subtitle tail.
fix: Reject `回` suffix matches when the tail starts with `合`, so in-body `回合` markers are not chapter candidates.
Reject sentence-ending colon tails whose prefix looks like dialogue or thought narration such as `她想` before the colon.
Add rule, scanner, parser, import, and checked-in representative corpus tests so the false positives stay in body text while real subtitle-punctuation chapter titles remain accepted.
Keep the external absolute-path corpus smoke test as supplemental evidence, not the only regression guard.
failed_attempts: Do not solve this by banning all colon subtitles with sentence punctuation; real corpus headings use this form.
Do not rely only on `/Users/longshengxi/Downloads/小说测试集`; that optional test can be skipped on machines without the local corpus.
impact: Prevents chapter-like prose inside a chapter from creating false TOC entries and corrupting body-offset based reading anchors.
